intro.text: A thief in Luthadel's underground, killed by an Inquisitor.

items.text: Was a member of Kelsier's crew, known and liked by many of the others. Kelsier envied him for knowing his feelings were never the work of emotional Allomancy.
Was caught and beheaded by an Inquisitor shortly before Kelsier came back to Luthadel from the Pits of Hathsin. With him gone, Clubs was brought in.
